ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/fix-loop.md`. The skill requires this before every fix round, and it decides who fixes and how the re-review runs.

ACTION: Read `docs/sync.md` around line 12 to confirm the text before editing.

ACTION: Edit `docs/sync.md:12` to change `--dry_run` to `--dry-run`. This fix is in one file, is a wrong name in docs, and changes no behavior. The skill lets me make it myself instead of dispatching a fix subagent.

ACTION: Commit the edit as its own commit.

ACTION: Append a note to the Task 3 implementer's report file in `.sdd/14-buoy-sync/`. The note says I changed the flag name in `docs/sync.md:12`, that it changes no behavior, and that no test covers it.

ACTION: Run `scripts/review-package specs/plans/14-buoy-sync.md <BASE> <HEAD>` for the fix commit. I pass the path it reports to the reviewer.

ACTION: Dispatch a scoped re-review with model `sonnet`, using `re-review-prompt.md`. The prompt holds F1 verbatim, the diff file path, and the plan's global constraints copied verbatim. The reviewer returns ADDRESSED or NOT ADDRESSED for F1 and reports any new Critical or Important issue.

Message to partner:

Task 3 has one Important finding. `docs/sync.md:12` says `--dry_run`, but the code uses `--dry-run`. I am fixing the docs line myself, then sending it to a scoped re-review.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- A flag name is a contract between the code and its docs. The tests check the code side only, so a docs typo passes every test. Only a reviewer who reads the docs finds it.
- The skill allows a self-made fix only for wording-level changes in one file. A change of even one character in code goes to a fix subagent.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`
